title: Brent offered Secret Agent Man by Barry Sonnenfeld

tellings.quote: years later, I'm offered a job on a show with Barry Senfeld as the executive producer called Secret Agent Man.

plain: Some time between 1997 and 1999 in Los Angeles, Brent Friedman, who has worked in film and television, was offered a job on a show called Secret Agent Man, with the director Barry Sonnenfeld as executive producer. Friedman tells Michels this from his own career, as part of an episode about Hollywood, the CIA and UFOs.
